backend.description: Concrete backend id such as tmux, herdr, cmux, or ci.

available.description: Whether the backend can currently address sessions.

wake_signal.description: Primary delivery surface for standby work, such as inject, notify, resume, or policy.

wake_intent.description: Command or condition the host checks to decide whether this agent should act.

delivery.description: Backend-specific delivery mode: native_wake, managed_session_injection, pane_notification, resume_or_prompt, or automation_policy.

commands.description: Optional command templates for run, inject, capture, stop, or backend-native wake.

failure_policy.description: Optional classification of blocking, warning-only, and invisible backend failures.
